an6.28:1.1: 28 ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhu bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
an6.28:1.2: atha kho tesaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi
an6.28:1.3: ko nu kho āvuso samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca
an6.28:2.2: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pāde pakkhāletvā nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā so samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:3.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
an6.28:3.2: na kho āvuso samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
an6.28:3.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pāde pakkhāletvā nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā cārittakilamathopissa tasmiṃ samaye appaṭippassaddho hoti bhattakilamathopissa tasmiṃ samaye appaṭippassaddho hoti
an6.28:3.4: tasmā so asamayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
an6.28:3.5: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito vihārapacchāyāyaṃ nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā so samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:4.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
an6.28:4.2: na kho āvuso samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
an6.28:4.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito vihārapacchāyāyaṃ nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā yadevassa divā samādhinimittaṃ manasikataṃ hoti tadevassa tasmiṃ samaye samudācarati
an6.28:4.4: tasmā so asamayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
an6.28:4.5: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā so samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:5.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
an6.28:5.2: na kho āvuso samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
an6.28:5.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā ojaṭṭhāyissa tasmiṃ samaye kāyo hoti phāsukassa hoti buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ
an6.28:5.4: tasmā so samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:6.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā mahākaccāno there bhikkhū etadavoca
an6.28:6.2: sammukhā me taṃ āvuso bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
an6.28:6.3: chayime bhikkhu samayā manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
an6.28:7.2: idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti tasmiṃ samaye manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo
an6.28:7.3: ahaṃ kho āvuso kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharāmi kāmarāgaparetena uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmi
an6.28:7.4: sādhu vata me āyasmā kāmarāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desetūti
an6.28:7.5: tassa manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu kāmarāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti
an6.28:7.6: ayaṃ bhikkhu paṭhamo samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati …pe…
an6.28:12.1: yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti taṃ nimittaṃ na jānāti na passati tasmiṃ samaye manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo

an6.28:12.3: sādhu vata me āyasmā āsavānaṃ khayāya dhammaṃ desetūti
an6.28:12.4: tassa manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayāya dhammaṃ deseti
an6.28:12.5: ayaṃ bhikkhu chaṭṭho samayo manobhāvaniyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:13.1: sammukhā me taṃ āvuso bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
